import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Radical
theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v0 ∣ p2v1) := by
  exact @Dvd.dvd.trans Nat _ p2v0 p2v2 p2v1 h0 h1

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v0 ≤ p2v0) := by
  exact @Preorder.le_refl Nat _ p2v0

theorem p2_n003 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v0 ∣ p2v0) := by
  exact @dvd_refl Nat _ p2v0

theorem p2_n004 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v0 ∣ 0) := by
  exact @dvd_zero Nat _ p2v0

theorem p2_n005 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v0 = p2v0) := by
  exact @Dvd.dvd.antisymm Nat _ p2v0 p2v0 _ (p2_n003 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 h0 h1) (p2_n003 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 h0 h1)

theorem p2_n006 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v1 ≤ p2v1) := by
  exact @Preorder.le_refl Nat _ p2v1

theorem p2_n007 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v1 ∣ p2v1) := by
  exact @dvd_refl Nat _ p2v1

theorem p2_n008 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (1 ∣ p2v1) := by
  exact @one_dvd Nat _ p2v1

theorem p2_n009 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v1)) : (0 ≤ p2v1) := by
  exact @zero_le Nat _ _ _ p2v1
